learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and skills needed for calculating and designing typical elements of devices and mechanisms.

syllabus_topics: General information about the design of devices
Elastic elements– flat, spiral, flat and spiral, bimetal and screw springs
Bearing fulcrums – rolling and gliding friction bearings
Fine mechanical transmissions– kinematical, accuracy and strength calculations
teaching_methods: Laboratory classes (experimental studies and problem solving)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (solving problems and answering control questions)

assessment_rules: The semester is verified if the reports are accepted, the course assignment defended, and classes regularly attended. The written exam consists of solving problems and answering control questions graded by a score system. The final mark depends on the number of points and the continuous assessment.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
